anchors.description: Visible top-rim width of the right-hand rounded dark-red upholstered form resting against the wall, measured from its left crease between the two humps to its right shoulder against the wall.
anchors.visible_evidence: Two similar rounded velvet-like upholstered humps sit against a plain wall; the right one's top rim is a crisp silhouette against the wall from x~267 to x~500, and the paired similar forms are consistent with upholstered back cushions or accent-chair backs.
anchors.identity_uncertainty: View is dim and oblique; cannot tell whether the form is a sofa back cushion, an accent-chair back, or a duvet-covered pillow, and scene depth is uncalibrated, so the prior interval spans roughly 0.64-1.02 m.
